methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This study aims to build a PDCA template based on ISO 50001 to solve the energy management problems of a company.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper develops a qualitative PDCA-cycle management framework/template based on ISO 50001, using the Delphi method and mean-score ranking to identify and prioritise energy-management risks in a health/beauty clinic. It presents no EnPI or EnB measurement model: no indicator/baseline normalisation variables, no functional form, and no construction/estimation approach are identified or characterised. ISO 50001 is discussed as a management system, not as a characterised measurement model, and no energy-performance figures are modelled. Ineligible as a framework/tool without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content (Stage-1 v2.3 exclusion).

paper_type.evidence_quote: This research use case study approach, conducted in a health care and beauty clinic which have an energy usage problem.

stage1.notes: Ineligible framework paper (no EnPI/EnB model). paper_type borderline between 'single applied case' (one clinic) and 'maturity model or framework' (PDCA template deliverable).
